name: Overhead crane & hoist inspection and repair for Illinois metals plants
summary: Hired crane technicians sell fixed-price OSHA 1910.179 periodic inspections to mid-size metals plants (avg ~8 cranes/hoists) and convert findings into repair/parts work; technicians added per ~$20k/month of revenue.
evidence_notes: Inspection list prices B: $108-$253 per crane periodic, $72-$169 frequent (Mazzella, C3-S001); labor $150-160/h (C3-S002).
Repair pull-through: Konecranes Industrial Service ~EUR 1.6B annual sales vs EUR 351.7M agreement base (~3.5x, incumbent, B, C3-S007); new entrant assumed 1.5/2.5/3.5x inspection revenue (E).
Federal awards A: 183rd Wing hoist inspections $30,328 (2 yrs) re-bid to $9,600/yr (DC-S025); crane repair task orders $8-19k (DC-S026).
Tech pay: Chicago industrial machinery mechanic median $75,800 (C, C3-S010); Konecranes Chicago tech $22-48/h (D, DC-S027).
ARPC base = 8 cranes x ~$200/yr inspections ($133/mo) + 2.5x repairs ($333) = $466 -> $470/mo.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Recruit experienced lead tech, GL/completed-ops insurance, service truck
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Plant budget cycles; inspection due dates
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Plant outreach to ~4,500 IL metals/machinery establishments (C3-S014)
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Fixed-price inspection quotes are the norm (C3-S002)
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Annual inspection contracts; Konecranes agreement base growing +5.1% (C3-S007) suggests stickiness; 183rd Wing re-bid shows price churn (DC-S025)
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Inspections $100/133/167 per month (C3-S001 list prices x ~8 cranes) + repairs 1.5/2.5/3.5x (E, C3-S007 ratio)
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Baseline inspection + deficiency backlog at takeover; federal repair task orders $8-19k (DC-S026) for scale
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Ex-tech-labor: parts ~40% of revenue at ~33% margin (Alta, C3-S031) + lift rental/consumables 5%
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Active PE roll-up of crane service (Crane 1/L Squared, WS03-S016); small-firm multiple assumed

staff.notes: Lead tech hired month 4 (quotes and first inspections); $85k base x1.25 (C3-S010 median $75.8k; DC-S027 $22-48/h)

capex.item: Rigging gear, load cell, tools, PPE, initial parts
